props.text: THE FIRST SUFFERING: THE CROWN. They pressed the thorns into his brow, and he did not lift his hand. Pilgrim, lay down what you wear upon your head, and your pride with it.
props.text_zh: 第一苦：戴冠。荆棘刺入他的额头，他不曾抬手。朝圣者，卸下你头上所戴之物，一并放下你的骄傲。

props.text: THE SECOND SUFFERING: THE SCOURGE. Bound to the pillar, he bled for every one of us. Pilgrim, lay down a cord: the scourge that was spared you.
props.text_zh: 第二苦：受鞭。他缚于刑柱之上，为众人流尽鲜血。朝圣者，献上一根绳索，那是你得以免受的鞭笞。

props.text: THE THIRD SUFFERING: HUNGER. He took no food, and was weighed upon the scales. His flesh at last weighed less than sin. Pilgrim, lay down a meal you will not eat.
props.text_zh: 第三苦：受饥。他断绝饮食，置身天平之上。他的肉身最终轻于罪。朝圣者，献上一餐，今日不食。

props.text: THE FOURTH SUFFERING: THE NAILS. Nailed by his hands and feet to the holy wood, he accepted death. Pilgrim, lay down metal, as he laid down his life.
props.text_zh: 第四苦：受钉。圣钉贯穿他的手足，将他钉于圣木之上，他接受了死亡。朝圣者，献上金属，如他献上生命。

props.text: THE FIFTH SUFFERING: THE LANCE. The lance pierced his heart, and the sun rose. Pilgrim, lay down a light, and the dawn will remember you.
props.text_zh: 第五苦：受枪。圣枪穿透他的心，太阳于是升起。朝圣者，献上一点光，黎明将记得你。

props.text: By the Church of the Five Sufferings, to every parish and every road: the Seal-bearers can no longer carry what Astra laid upon them. Dusk comes earlier, dawn later; should the five Seals fail, the Long Night falls a second time. The pilgrimage is called. Let the pilgrim seek out the five Seal-bearers, bring back the five instruments, and come to the Holy City for the Rite of the Five Sufferings. Named to this road: the one who came down from the mountain with a fairy. — Sealed in the Holy City.
props.text_zh: 五苦圣教，致各教区、各条道路：五位持印者已无法继续承担阿斯特拉留下的五苦。黄昏一日早过一日，黎明一日迟过一日；五印若尽衰，第二次极夜终将降临。今召朝圣。朝圣者当寻访五位持印者，取回五件圣刑之器，前往圣城，重行五苦大礼。受命踏上此路者：从山上下来、身边跟着一只妖精的人。——圣城用印

props.text: Sunset after sunset in a neat column, each a little earlier than the last. On the last pages the hand changes — hurried, pressed so hard the pen has torn the paper: "No sun today. None today. He says he will take it all. Whoever reads this — stop him." After that, nothing.
props.text_zh: 一行行工整的日落时刻，每一行都比上一行早一点。最后几页，字迹变了——仓促，用力得笔尖划破了纸：「今天没有太阳。今天也没有。他说他会把一切都担下来。读到这里的人——阻止他。」再往后，什么也没有。

props.text: A bronze seal on a chain: a ring of thorns, and in it a knight kneeling — not before a lord, before a child. Around the rim: WE HOLD, THAT OTHERS NEED NOT.
props.text_zh: 链子上挂着一枚青铜印章：一圈荆棘，圈里一个骑士单膝跪下——跪的不是领主，而是一个孩子。边缘刻着：我们坚守，好让别人不必。

props.text: A writ of relief under the wax seal of the Order. It reads: Alberic, Bearer of the Crown, has borne the seal forty years; another shall be sent to relieve him. — The wax is whole. It was never opened, and never sent. On the back, one line in fresher ink: "No one could be found who would bear it. Let him go on holding."
props.text_zh: 一份盖着骑士团火漆的替任文书。上面写着：持冠者阿尔贝里克承印已满四十年，当另派一人接替。——火漆完好，没有拆过，也没有寄出去。背面有一行字，墨色比正文新："找不到愿意承受的人。就让他继续守着吧。"

rules.doc: Using a thing on something its nature says nothing about: the bare body used on anything is a blow (Minecraft's fist), and so is anything swung; on a place of the overworld it is out of reach; on a creature it is held out to it (the creature answers: offered, design.md §5.2). rules.doc: Putting the host somewhere (physics: never asked): a person is handed it, anything else that lives does not take what is put on it, anything else receives it.
A bound thing (the Oath-Thorn: the way into a place one carries) does not leave its bearer's hand for another's; put anywhere else, it is put as anything is.
Taking the target with the hands: it is taken (and answers how).

A bare hand on the target: it is handled (and answers how); what the hand asks of it rides along — a companion's boon, what is said to a person (a talk verb, its choice, the thing it is about; the offer or topic of a quest, docs/quests.md).
Moving: one step, or to a place.
Crafting what the recipe makes from what is carried.
Learning what the act names: a skill (with skill points), a profession (at a trainer).
What is done to a thing is undefined unless its nature says (the AI answers).

A blow on something with no answer of its own: a built thing that can be carried (a bed, a workbench, a chest, a wall) struck with a tool (an axe, a pickaxe, a hammer) comes loose whole, what it holds spilling, to be picked up (design.md §5.2: what F took down) — not a locked one, which is only worn; else what has durability loses it (as well as the instrument works on what it is made of; nothing if the instrument is softer — too hard), and the element the blow carries reaches it; a plain blow on what cannot break is undefined.
A bare hand on something with no answer of its own: undefined (meanwhile one only runs a hand over it).
Asked to take a posture at a thing (a chair, hay, an altar): an actor goes there and holds it until it moves on (its status ends as it steps away); anything else is undefined.
A portable thing taken moves into the taker's hand (or bag, or onto the ground); anything else stays where it is (taking is physics: never asked).
Something put on a thing with no answer of its own: there is no room there.
Something held out to one with no answer of its own: undefined (the AI answers).
Health or hunger given back; or a night's sleep (until it is time to rise, giving back as the room says); a warm spring's mending (health, and one is soaking while it goes on).
News: noted, nothing changes, unless the host says.
Oil coats whatever is not water.
A pushed actor steps (or gets out of where it cannot be); a pushed thing is undefined.
Elements follow physics: fire burns the flammable and lights the lightable, water wets and douses, ice freezes the wet, lightning charges the wet and the conductive; otherwise no change.
Touching is no change unless the host says.
Physics of touch: what burns burns what touches it (stepping into fire, a burning thing put down on straw); charged ground shocks what stands on it; wet ground wets it; otherwise no change.
Bumping is no change unless the host says.
Time passing is no change unless the host says.

A clock running out: a thing in a stage whose clock it is becomes what its stage says next (a stump a tree, a sprout a young plant, thin ice water; a hen lays) — world-model.md §6.5; for anything else, no change.
Gaining or losing a status, crossing a line: no change unless the host says.
What stood on something and stands on nothing now falls to the first floor below (physics: defined, never asked; nothing happens while a floor is there).

Something with durability at none (world-model.md §6.3): an essential one goes down (and comes to); one made of something breaks down into it (its makeup × the recovery rate) and spills what it holds; anything else is undefined (meanwhile it is gone).
Seeing an act is no change unless the seer says.
A person who cannot go on: undefined (the AI answers); meanwhile they wait.
Content the story must keep playable broke: undefined (the AI answers); meanwhile its authored fallback runs.

One who has fallen, told by the story to rise (the death screen's choice): one gets up, whole — leaving what one carried bundled where one fell (one's coin loose beside it) and telling the bosses there that one is gone (each is whole again), when one rises at home (but what one wears, the weapon in one's hand and what is important stay with one). Told of a home (a bed slept in, a waypoint woken), one keeps it.

text.en: You rise again. What you carried lies bundled where you fell, your coin scattered beside it; what you wore and what matters most are still with you.
text.zh: 你重新站了起来。身上的东西打成一包留在了倒下的地方，钱撒在旁边；穿戴的装备和重要物品还在身上。

rules.doc: One's belongings, bundled where one fell: a hand on the bundle, or taking it, and all of it comes back to whoever opens it; the bundle is gone.
One's belongings, bundled where one fell, picked up (E): opened as by a hand — all of it comes back to the taker; the bundle is gone. An empty one is taken as anything is.

A built thing lying loose (design.md §5.2: packed where it came loose, or where G put it down), picked up: the thing itself comes out to the taker; the pack is gone (an empty one is taken as anything is).
Something one wears, used on one (one's own, or another's held out): one puts it on (what was in its slot comes off), or takes it off if it is on (world-model.md §6.8).

An actor struck takes the blow as anything with durability does — as well as what struck works on what it is made of (world-model.md §6.1, §6.8; a frozen one shatters under a blunt or earthen blow); the one who struck becomes its foe; the element of the blow reaches it.

Elements on a body: fire sets it burning (steam off the wet, thaw off the frozen, hurting either way); the fiery and the icy are healed by their own element and hurt by its opposite; lightning arcs through the wet; wind blows it away.

At no health: the essential (people, the player) go down for a while (as anything essential); the rest break down into what they are made of and spill what they carried (lying still: taken with F), and the one who struck learns from it (world-model.md §6.8, D9); a boss tells the story which boss fell (the fogs of its room lift, docs/boss-rooms.md).
The essential come to with half their health.

Whoever defeated a foe gains experience as much as its full health, and may find the foe kind's own piece of gear in their bag (a chance each felling, sure at the fiftieth: the trophy primitive) (and is rewarded with experience when a quest is handed in; told of a deed's weight, what = karma or faith, its karma or faith moves by delta). A mage felling a foe with a staff mends 3 (Arcane Recovery); an assassin felling one with a dagger mends a tenth of their health (Shadow Recovery): a profession's talents answer its own weapons only (profession.ts).
A bleeding body loses 1 health a second, through any defence (Hemorrhage's wound): in the name of whoever opened it.
Adrenaline (the skill): while the rush lasts the body mends 1 a second.
A training dummy knocked down (no health left) stands up again, whole, and the story hears of it (the tutorial's blow lesson waits on it).

rules.doc: Under six tenths of a full food bar one is hungry (hunger falls slowly then: a body goes days without food); fed over it again, one is not.

Hunger (Minecraft's food bar): it drains — fast while fed, slowly once hungry; well fed (90 % and up) the body heals, starving (0) it loses health, but never the last point. A meal had while nobody watched (the clock's `tended`) feeds one.

The story tells a person where it stands (the player's stage): they keep it. Told to step into a pocket place (what = pocket: the Oath-Thorn's Held Ground), they go — or, in it, come back out. Told to mend (what = mend: the Mend skill), they mend by as much. Told to pay, to hand something over, to give back what is not theirs, to go to the cells; told the news, reminded to chat, told to calm down, called to help (docs/npc-sandbox.md).

A person handed a thing takes it: their own brought back, they let go what they held against the one who took it; a gift, they warm to the giver as its worth says — the kind they like best (their favourite, docs/npc-sandbox.md §2.15) delights them, +30 once a day — and say what they make of it (one put on them is theirs to wear).

rules.doc: A hand on a person: a quest they have for you, else what fits the moment, and their talk opens (§2.9). Asked (a talk verb): news, a chat (one of their chat lines, or once what they like best), a gift (the panel), to follow, to wait, bribed, robbed (might against might: overwhelmed they hand over coin and goods, else they beat the robber to a point of health), a hand in their pocket (a roll of nimbleness: unnoticed it takes coin and a thing, caught the thief is beaten to half), told there are no gods, an apology, what was taken given back, stopped by the watch; a minor by tag or recorded age is explicitly refused robbery, theft, unbelief and intimidation; a word no rule knows is theirs to answer (the AI's).

rules.doc: A merchant asked to trade shows its goods (its stock, made up once a day); asked for one of them (param item), it sells it at its price; offered a thing (the instrument), it buys it if it is the seller's to sell — a fence buys what is not (§2.10).

One who keeps the watch, having stopped one it wants: paid, the bounty is cleared (and what was not theirs taken back); refused, or too poor, the cells; talked round or bribed (not for blood); resisted, it fights and calls the watch (§2.7).

rules.doc: A person who did a deed sees it too, witnessed or not: its karma falls (conscience). A person who sees a deed takes it in (who did it, or how they looked) and answers by who they are: the watch at once; the wronged cry out or ask back, and people talk of a theft; witnesses tell the watch, unless they keep quiet. Seeing someone where they should not be, a stranger they remember, a blade drawn, one the watch wants: they say so. An act the world had no answer for is asked once, of its host; what it comes to is seen when it is answered (§2.6, §2.12).

rules.doc: A witness on its way (reporting), or an owner whose thing did not come back (demanding): the watch is told.
Each morning one has one's purse again (a day's wage), and a merchant its stock.
Each morning a household's larder has its provisions again (its `stock`): what its people's work brings in.
A person at no health who is not essential dies (the essential go down): one who struck learns from it, people will talk of it, and they become their body, a container of what they carried (§2.8).
Taken hold of by one sneaking (E, sneaking): a person's pockets are open to the hand — each thing taken from them is an act, seen or not (§2.10).
A thing put on a person by one sneaking (G) goes into their pocket unasked: a hand in a pocket, seen or not (§2.10).
A hand on what a person left (a body, bones): one searches it — what they carried is there to take (and taking it is taking what is another's).
A watch keeps its ledger: a deed reported raises the doer's bounty by its fine (each deed once); paid, or pardoned, the bounty is cleared (§2.7).
Only a resident work order or its own transient work step is handled by the resident work module; worker-side authorization is checked again by its own-host primitive.

rules.doc: A built thing (a wall, a floor, a door, stairs) used on open ground, a floor or what is built there (the right click, the build palette) is set up there: the cell takes it as it takes what G puts, but it stands (param build) where what G puts lies loose. Used on anything else, or swung as a blow, it is what its nature says.

A fixture (a bed, a workbench) used on open ground, a floor or what is built there (the right click, the build palette) is set up there: the cell takes it as it takes what G puts, but it stands (param build) where what G puts lies loose. Used on anything else, or swung as a blow, it is what its nature says.
A document with something written in it (its text, text_zh), used on oneself, is read; one with nothing written is the world's to answer.
A skill book used on oneself is read: one is told the skill it teaches (its `teaches`), and learns it from the book (body/stage, what = read).
Something one wears, used on someone (oneself, or another): it is put on them (world-model.md §6.8).

Food used on oneself is eaten: it feeds hunger (Minecraft: health comes back from being well fed, not from the bite). Used on another who gets hungry, it feeds them; on anything else it is undefined (a wolf offered meat: the AI answers).
Medicine eaten (a healing herb) heals as well as it feeds — oneself, or another it is given to.

text.en: You eat {host}, and know what it is good for.
text.zh: 你吃下{host}，你很清楚它的药效。

rules.doc: A drink used on oneself, or on another living thing, heals them.
A drink carried in a vessel (a bucket of milk), drunk by oneself or given to another: it heals and feeds them, and the vessel is left empty.
Water poured on something (or drunk, if it is oneself): water reaches it, and the vessel is empty. Putting a vessel down only sets it down.
Oil poured on something coats it; the vessel is empty.
An empty vessel at water (a well, a fountain, a lake) fills.
A flame held to something: fire reaches it (the flammable burn, the lightable are lit). A torch put down is only set down.
Raw food held over a lit fire cooks.
A blade used on something strikes it with a cutting edge — on a person only with the blade drawn (X: a blow on a person is meant).
A spear or a halberd used on something strikes it with a point — on a person only with it drawn.
A weapon used on something strikes it — on a person only with it drawn.
A wand cast at something strikes it with its element — at a person only with it drawn.
A pickaxe works what it is used on: a blow with a pierce edge.
A hoe works what it is used on: a blow with a dig edge.
A shovel works what it is used on: a blow with a dig edge.
A sickle works what it is used on: a blow with a cut edge.
A hammer works what it is used on: a blow with a blunt edge.
A key, a quill, a fishing line, a lockpick: a careful hand on the target, with the instrument in it.
A key, a quill, a fishing line, a lockpick: a careful hand on the target, with the instrument in it.
A key, a quill, a fishing line, a lockpick: a careful hand on the target, with the instrument in it.
A key, a quill, a fishing line, a lockpick: a careful hand on the target, with the instrument in it.
A rope used on a fixture is tied to it (it receives the rope).
Open ground takes what is put down on it.
The open air of a storey above the ground takes what something there would hold up: a floor laid in it, a wall set on the wall below (docs/building.md).
Solid ground (walls, trees, rock) takes nothing.
Water refuses what is put in it, so nothing is lost.
Lava takes what is put in it (and burns what can burn).
Something put on a loose item lies beside it.
A table, counter, bench or altar takes what is set on it (it lies on that tile).

An open container takes what is put in it, up to its capacity — the capacity is its slots, not its things: a slot holds a stack of one kind (what a kind already there takes no new slot, so a stack with room still takes one more); a closed one takes nothing.
A lit fire takes what is fed to it: the flammable burn there; raw food set on a fire made for cooking (cookware) is held to it, as use/cook holds it there.
Raw food in fire cooks.
A container stays where it is: closed it says so, open its contents are taken from its panel.

text.en: Take what is inside from it.

rules.doc: A hand opens or closes a container; a key locks or unlocks it; a lockpick, worked at a lock, may spring it (and one who sees it knows what it is).

rules.doc: A hand on something written: it is read.
An axe on a living tree bites into it: it loses durability (as any blow) and shows a notch, which heals if the tree is left alone.
A notch left alone heals: the tree is whole again.
A living tree broken falls: a stump that grows back, two logs, a stick, and now and then an acorn (a woodcutter gets a log more); one broken by fire is a charred tree.
A shovel digs a stump out for good.
An axe breaks a charred tree down to coal.

text.en: The charred wood crumbles to coal.

rules.doc: An axe splits a log into two planks.

text.en: You split the log into planks.

rules.doc: Ice turns water into walkable ice, spreading a little (the cast's own cell spreads to those beside it, and no further); that ice thaws in time.
Fire on ice turns it back to water.
Whoever finds water closing over them (the ice gave way) is put ashore.
Burning never takes hold on water.
Lightning on conductive ground (water) charges it and arcs to the conductive and the wet around.
Burnt ground is ash; a burnt tree is charred, a burnt wall black (a building's walls are scorched, never burnt away); what else burns on the ground (a bush, a stump) is gone.
A burning thing with durability (a body, a tree, a wooden wall) loses it as it burns, now and then (an element is a damage channel, world-model.md §6.2).

A wall the maps are built of (a house's, a chapel's, a keep's: docs/building.md §10) hit down to nothing does not give way: it holds at its last crack, solid, nothing falling out of it — the way into a house is its door. A fire on it wears it to the same crack and leaves it black when it goes out (fire/burn-out-ground). What one builds oneself breaks as anything does.
A plank laid on shallow water, or a trunk fallen across it, makes a stretch of bridge.
A burning thing reaches its flammable neighbours now and then (dry things fast).
A burning thing reaches its flammable neighbours now and then (dry things fast).
A burning thing reaches its flammable neighbours now and then (dry things fast).
A burning thing reaches its flammable neighbours now and then (dry things fast).
A burning thing reaches its flammable neighbours now and then (dry things fast).
A fiery creature sets alight the dry, flammable things it comes up against or walks over.
A fiery creature that runs up against something dry and flammable sets it alight.
A warm spring mends whoever sits in it: a little health as they step in (a splash), and more for as long as they stay.
A warm spring mends whoever sits in it: a little health as they step in (a splash), and more for as long as they stay.
Lava burns what lies on it, and goes on burning it.
Lava burns what lies on it, and goes on burning it.
A burnt thing leaves ash and what it held.
A wooden wall, floor, door or stair that burns down to nothing (fire/wear) is ash, not its planks; a short fire only scorches it.
Something explosive that catches fire goes off: a blow as strong as its blast to everything round it, fire to what burns there, and it is gone.
A burnt item is ash.
Water that freezes is ice (thin: it thaws).
Breakable fixtures shatter when broken and spill their contents (into their makeup, if they have one).
Earth shatters what is fragile.
A material put on another to build: it gives itself to the work.
A material put on another to build: it gives itself to the work.
A frame takes planks up to four; a hammer makes a crate of two or a chest of four.

rules.doc: Nothing put into unfinished work is lost: it comes apart into its materials.
A blank sign: bare-handed it is blank; a quill writes on it while you carry ink. Until free-text input exists, it writes one fixed line.
A material put on another to build: it gives itself to the work.
A watered crop grows on its own stage clock. Retained water carries a sprout through the next stage; the final stage spends all water, including before a perennial grows back.
A seed put on bare farmland takes root as its crop.
An acorn takes root in any diggable ground and becomes a tree in two game days.
Water on a growing crop starts a full stage at its own pace; Irrigation supplies the next stage too.
Ash worked into a growing crop's soil is used up.
Fertilizer (the stall's) worked into a growing crop's soil is used up.
Ash (or fertilizer) on a growing crop: one more of the crop at harvest.

text.en: You work ash into the soil.
You work fertilizer into the soil.

rules.doc: A sickle harvests a ripe crop: its yield and two seeds (a perennial grows back); more by the harvester's skills — Bountiful, Farmer, the skill of the crop's kind (crop:<kind>), Golden Harvest, Perennial Keeper (life.ts).
Picking a ripe crop by hand (E: a crop is handled, not taken — it stands in its soil): one of the crop and one seed (a perennial grows back).
A shovel lifts a plant and gives back its seed.

The world's clocks: what appears by itself appears (the ground's yield, creatures that come back, the night's walkers); rain wets the people and creatures out under it and douses fires; a storm's lightning seeks what stands tall.
News for the story: something people will talk about while it is fresh.
A profession trainer, spoken to: a quest if they have one, a word, and the choice of profession (from level 5; a change gives back the profession branch's points); asked anything else, as anyone.

A companion, spoken to (E), tells what the story asks for now and how (else what it last pointed out), and opens its panel: what the main road asks now, and the five seals' powers, those taken up and those still sealed (one is changed only beside a woken waypoint). Asked to carry one of its boons (param boon, from that panel), it takes it up if a woken waypoint is near (boons.ts).
A light the story tells to go out or to burn (notify what = status, remove or add lit: a scene's `status`) answers itself: a flame taken, a lamp lit for a feast.
A companion struck by the one it follows takes the blow as any blow, and says so: it is no silent target. A blow from anyone else is a blow.

text.en: Ow! It is me — watch where you swing!

rules.doc: A companion told it is given a boon (notify what = boon, param unlock: its id) keeps it, and carries it if it carries none (boons.ts).
A companion sees someone try what the world has never seen (an act it has no answer for): it tells the story, which counts the experiments (the prologue waits for the first).
The night-born crumble away in daylight, a few at a time.

The story is told an offer was taken on (what = accept, param quest: the actor took it from the source, its giver): the quest begins. Told facts to keep (what = facts: a quest's reward), it keeps them.

The Story Manager: the story sees the world's news (a step played, a fact kept, a quest over, a place entered, the evening, a theft, the hungry): the quests that begin on it begin, the radiant offers on it are made (docs/quests.md §2.3).
A quest sees news it listens for (who its taker spoke to, what was felled or is gone, what the taker holds and where they are, the story's facts, the other quests): it moves on as its triggers say.
A quest told to reach a stage (what = stage, param n: a scene's, a rule's), to be taken on (accept: by the actor), turned down (decline), or that it failed (fail): it answers itself.
A quest's time runs out (its status due): an offer is withdrawn, a quest under way fails.
The commission board (docs/quests.md §3): read with a hand, it shows the favours people want done (its panel); asked to take one on (say quest), the quest named is taken on.
People and creatures are not picked up (taking is physics: never asked).
A hand on a waypoint statue wakes it (once): it remembers you, and the world map (M) can take you to it. Woken, it hums, and opens the panel where the companion's boon is chosen.

text.en: A cool calm spreads under your skin: fire will hardly touch you now.

rules.doc: A hand on a tent that has a room (its interior props): one goes in, out again by its flap in front of it. A tent with none: no change.
A shut door taken hold of opens: what walks may pass.
An open door taken hold of shuts.
A bed, taken hold of: one lies down and sleeps until it is time to rise (a bed in a bedroom gives a full night's rest).
Something put on a built thing goes on top of it: it comes to rest on the lowest storey with room for it there (a floor laid over a wall, a bed set on a floor).

A floor that loses what held it up (the wall under it broken) and has nothing else to hold it comes down: it breaks, and what stood on it falls. One taken down into a bag or a hand has not lost its footing: it was carried off.
A hand on the Held Ground's stall: its shelves and what it buys back are shown (the shop panel; buying and selling are made there).
Feed given to a beast: it is told it is fed (and answers itself); the feed is eaten.
Feed given to a beast: it is told it is fed (and answers itself); the feed is eaten.

A beast fed is fed for a day (Stardew's hay, Minecraft's wheat): content; a configured steward may ask this animal to confirm a one-animal legacy ownership claim in its own outcome; a fed cow can be milked, and told it is milked, it is milked for the day.

A cow fed (not resting from young) calls to the fed cows beside it; one that hears the call (fed, not resting) bears its young beside it, and both rest a day (the caller is told); told it is milked, a cow is milked for the day.

An empty bucket used on a cow: fed and not yet milked today, it gives milk (the bucket is a bucket of milk, the cow is told); unfed, it will not.

rules.doc: Bait used on a fishing rod: matching bait adds its own casts to the rod; different bait cannot be mixed until the current bait is spent. The bait is used up only when accepted.

The bait host checks the rod it was actually used on before it destroys itself. Its own stack identity is derived by the engine and carried to the rod only after a match; stale or different bait leaves the bait untouched.

A fishing rod keeps its bait: told it is baited, it has that many more casts; told a baited cast is spent, one fewer.

Food told it is eaten (snapped up by a creature it was held out to: creature/offered) is gone; any other news it only notes.
A bare hand reached toward a wild creature: it snaps at the hand and takes the reacher for a foe. An animal is its own to answer.

On what stands in the cell (`standing`: a tree, a bush, rock, a wall, a stump) the hand is a deliberate act the base does not answer: the world says what comes of it, and with no model it is only touched.

A hand on a loom (E): its panel opens — what is made at it, from what one carries, made at this one. Nothing else is needed: no standing beside it while one makes.

An ore vein broken spills half the ore it holds (as anything broken does); a prospector gets more of its ore (mineOre), a gem-finder now and then a gem. What is left is its spent face (`spent`: bedrock, that no tool breaks), whole again, which grows back into the vein in a day (ontology.ts VEIN_REGROWS).

text.en: Something glitters in the rubble — a gem!
text.zh: 碎石里有东西在闪——是宝石！

text.en: {host} breaks; the face is bare. It will show ore again in a day.
text.zh: {host}碎了，只剩光秃秃的岩面。一天后又会露出矿来。

rules.doc: A blow on a vein's spent face: bare rock, harder than any tool; nothing comes of it but dust, and a word that the vein shows again in a day.

text.en: Bare rock. The vein will show again in a day.
text.zh: 光秃秃的岩面。矿脉要一天后才会再露出来。

rules.doc: Rock or a boulder broken breaks down into stone; a stonecutter gets more (mineStone).
A cow felled is defeated as any creature is (combat/defeat: the striker learns from it, the story hears, it breaks down into its meat, lying still); a butcher gets more meat, a tanner its hide.

A chicken felled is defeated as any creature is (combat/defeat: the striker learns from it, the story hears, it breaks down into its meat, lying still); a butcher gets more meat, a plucker its feathers.
A hand on a mushroom ring picks its mushrooms (a forager more); it grows them again in a day.

text.en: Nothing left to pick — they grow back in a day.
text.zh: 已经采光了——一天后会再长出来。

rules.doc: A sickle cuts reeds for grass (a forager more); they grow again in a day.

text.en: The reeds are cut short. Give them a day.
text.zh: 芦苇已经割短了，过一天再来。

text.en: You cut an armful of reeds.

rules.doc: A hand on a beehive (or a bee box) takes its honey once a day — and the bees sting, unless one keeps bees (Beekeeper); a beekeeper takes more (honey).

text.en: The bees have not filled it again yet.
text.zh: 蜜蜂还没把它重新酿满。

text.en: You calm the bees and take the honey.
text.zh: 你安抚好蜜蜂，取出了蜂蜜。

text.en: You take the honey — and the bees sting!
text.zh: 你取到了蜂蜜——但被蜜蜂蜇了！

rules.doc: A bucket of milk heated over a lit fire (any cookware) makes cheese — two, more for a cheesemaker (cheese) — and the bucket is empty again.

text.en: The milk curdles over the fire — cheese.
text.zh: 牛奶在火上凝结——做成了奶酪。

rules.doc: Diggable ground told it is tilled (a wide hoe's swing beside it) turns to farmland.
A growing crop told it is watered (a sprinkler's watering beside it) is watered.

What a skill leaves clinging to a body: a mire that slows it, a trance or a kneel or a stun that holds it (and steadies it a while after, so no hold follows a hold), a web, venom, a bleed, a beast's frenzy.
A poisoned body loses 1 health a second, through any defence (a spider's venom).
A slime's Hop: it leaps onto the foe's cell and splashes the cells around it, in its own element.
A wolf's Lunge: it dashes along the row to the first foe and bites, opening a bleed; its Howl, hurt: every beast near is frenzied, itself too.
A wolf's Lunge: it dashes along the row to the first foe and bites, opening a bleed; its Howl, hurt: every beast near is frenzied, itself too.
A boar's Charge: it runs headlong down the row; the first foe it meets is struck hard, thrown back two cells and stunned; it runs into a wall or a tree and is stunned itself.
A bat's Swoop: it darts down the row to the first foe, bites, drinks a little of it and springs back.
A zombie's Grasp: it reaches out on every side; what it catches is held, slowed as in a mire.
A skeleton's Bone Toss: a bone thrown down the row at the foe.
A ghost's Wail: those around it are struck senseless a moment, and touched by its cold.
A golem's Ground Slam: slow to rise, it brings both fists down; all around it are struck in its element and thrown back a cell.
An imp's Fireball: it lobs fire onto the foe's cell and the cells around it.
A wisp's Discharge: lightning runs out from the foe's cell along the row and the column.
A spider's Web Spit: what stands on the cells it spits on is webbed, wading at a third of the pace. Its bite is venomous: one bite in four poisons.
A sporecap's Spore Cloud: it puffs its spores out two cells round it; those in it are struck a little and poisoned.
A whelp's Ember Breath: a cone of fire before it.
A crab's Shell Up, hurt: it draws into its shell, hard to hurt and slow a while.

The barrow warden's skills: his Vigil Sweep cuts the cone before him and drives back a cell; his Shield Charge runs down the row to the first foe, stuns it and sweeps at once; hurt, he Holds the Post: the ring three cells out is struck and mired, and no hold breaks his wind-up.

The cyclops's skills: it throws a boulder onto the foe's cell and those round it; it stomps, striking all round it and driving them back, and the aftershock runs out to the ring beyond; its Baleful Glare down the row stuns whoever meets its eye.
The Slime King's skills: its Royal Bounce lands on the foe and splashes two cells round it; hurt, it Splits: two green slimes come off it, once.
A cobweb holds who wades into it: webbed, at a third of the pace (a spider walks its own; a flyer never touches it).
A cobweb torn by a blow or burnt through is gone.
A cobweb sags away when its while is out.
The antidote, drunk — by oneself, or by another it is given to: it clears poison and mends a little.
The antidote's coat: poison is gone, and the body mends 4.

The White Knight's skills: his arrows and his volley pierce; his thorns cut and make the struck kneel; the line of briars he grows makes those on it kneel and stays a while, and so does the hedge he closes round himself when he holds; his hilt drives back one who stands too close.

The dragon's skills: its breath burns the cone it sees and leaves embers; three bolts of fire, each where its foe stands then; a dive down the row that leaves embers behind; its tail drives back those beside it, its bite tears those before it; at half health it calls its brood (once), at a quarter the ash falls in two waves.

text.en: The dragon shrieks. Its whelps pour out of the dark!
text.zh: 魔龙一声尖啸，幼龙从黑暗里涌了出来！

rules.doc: The Velvet Lure · Lust's skills, as they were: each blow in turn, with what it pulls, pushes or leaves clinging.
The Face Thief · Envy's skills, as they were: each blow in turn, with what it pulls, pushes or leaves clinging.
The Crown Without a King · Pride's skills, as they were: each blow in turn, with what it pulls, pushes or leaves clinging.
None cross that do not kneel: one who steps into the White Knight's briars is cut and made to kneel (a flyer never touches them; a boss wades through its own).
The White Knight's briars, cut or burnt through, are gone: nothing of them is left to gather.
The White Knight's briars wither when their while is out.
The dragon's embers die down when their while is out.
A hand on the general store's counter: its shelves are shown (the shop panel; buying and selling are made there) — unless it is a written thing (readable, with a text), which is read (core/read).
A hand on the chapel's bookstand: its shelves are shown (the shop panel; buying and selling are made there) — unless it is a written thing (readable, with a text), which is read (core/read).
The optional fishing module owns a configured map's hidden cast, bite, fight and catch; only its actor outcome can grant the selected fish.

text.en: A fish bites! Hold to raise the zone; release to lower it.
text.zh: 有鱼咬钩了！按住抬高控制区，松开让它下降。

text.en: Your pack is too full; the fish got away.

rules.doc: The dresser (a person tagged dresser), asked to change one's look (the talk verb restyle): her panel opens — the character creator over one's own look, for the price params.restyle names (coin and wildflowers), taken when the new look is kept. Anything else said, as to anyone.

text.en: Sit down, then. Let's see what we can do with you.
text.zh: 坐下吧。让我看看能给你做点什么。

rules.doc: A hand on a standing mirror: one looks oneself over, and the restyle panel opens (the dresser's price holds, whether she is beside it or not).

text.en: You look yourself over in the glass.

rules.doc: The snapped ferry rope says what it needs.

text.en: The ferry rope snapped at the drum; the frayed end trails in the water. A good length of rope would mend it.
text.zh: 渡绳在绞盘上断了，磨烂的一头拖在水里。有一段结实的绳子就能接上。

rules.doc: A rope given to the broken winch is spliced onto its drum: the ferry line runs again.

text.en: You splice the rope onto the drum. The line runs taut across the water again.
text.zh: 你把绳子接在绞盘上。渡绳又绷直了，横过水面。

rules.doc: With the line mended, the ferrykeeper takes you across.
An axe bites into the dead tree at the narrows; the third blow fells it away from the axe — across the river, if the river lies that way.

text.en: The dead tree creaks, leans, and comes down with a crash.
text.zh: 枯树嘎吱作响，慢慢歪向一边，轰的一声倒了下去。

text.en: The axe bites into the dead wood. The trunk creaks.
text.zh: 斧头砍进枯木，树身嘎吱响了一声。

rules.doc: The hungry peddler trades his frost wand for a meal.

text.en: Bless you, friend. The wand on my cart, the blue one, it's yours. Point it right and frost comes off the tip.
text.zh: 谢天谢地，朋友。我车上那根魔杖，蓝的那根，归你了。指准了，杖尖就会冒出寒气来。

rules.doc: Once traded, the peddler does not mind the wand being taken.

text.en: That one's yours now. Mind the cold, though. It gets into the hand that holds it.
text.zh: 那根现在是你的了。不过小心点，那股寒气连握着它的手都会冻着。

rules.doc: The wand the peddler gave away is no longer his: told so, it is nobody's (and so the one who holds it may keep it, and no one cries thief).
The story hears what happened at the ford and keeps it: the line mended, the tree felled, the wand traded; asked for the crossing, it plays the ferry.
The elder tells of the dragon and what it will take (once).
smith takes iron_ore toward the 5 asked for.

text.en: Good iron, that! Five ore and three coal, and you'll have your blade.
text.zh: 好铁！五块矿石、三块煤，你的剑就有了。

text.en: That's iron enough. Now the coal, if you haven't brought it yet.
text.zh: 铁够了。还差煤，你要是还没拿来的话。

rules.doc: smith takes coal toward the 3 asked for.

text.en: Coal! That'll burn hot enough to work dragon-steel.
text.zh: 煤！这下炉子能烧到炼屠龙钢的火候了。

rules.doc: With five ore and three coal, the smith forges Dragonsbane.

text.en: There it is. Dragonsbane. My family has waited twelve generations to forge that blade. Come back with the dragon's blood on it!
text.zh: 好了，屠龙剑！我们家等了十二代，才等到锻这把剑。带着龙血回来见我！
加里克把屠龙剑交到你手里。

rules.doc: herbalist takes fireweed toward the 3 asked for.

text.en: Fireweed! The books say it only grows where there's been a fire.
text.zh: 火焰草！书上说，它只长在着过火的地方。

rules.doc: herbalist takes frostcap toward the 3 asked for.

text.en: Frostcap, from the shady side of Hushwood. Good.
text.zh: 霜盖菇，噤声林背阴那边长的。很好。

rules.doc: With three fireweed and three frostcap, the herbalist brews two fireproof draughts.

text.en: Two draughts. Drink one at the lair's mouth, and for a few minutes the fire will barely warm you. The other is for when the first wears off.
text.zh: 两瓶药剂。到了巢穴门口喝一瓶，之后几分钟里，火烧到身上也只是有点暖。第一瓶药效过了，就喝另一瓶。

text.en: Wren gives you two fireproof draughts.
text.zh: 雷恩给了你两瓶防火药剂。

rules.doc: Once the dragon is slain, its whelps lose heart and scatter into the dark, one by one: the victory is not followed by a fight one can no longer win the story for.

text.en: A whelp shrieks and flees into the dark.
text.zh: 一只幼龙尖叫着逃进了黑暗。

rules.doc: The dragon falls: what it leaves, the experience of it, and the end of the main quest.
The story hears what happened past the Ford and keeps it: what the smith and the herbalist were given, the blade and the draughts, the whelps, the dragon slain; the council.
The story counts the waypoint statues woken, the meals eaten and the experiments a companion saw (the prologue waits for the first of each).
The story keeps which sins have fallen, which legendary arms they have left, and which of the bosses with a room have fallen (docs/boss-rooms.md).
Pell's drawing (stone), read with a hand: what it shows, and the story hears it was found.
Pell's drawing (door), read with a hand: what it shows, and the story hears it was found.
Pell's drawing (bridge), read with a hand: what it shows, and the story hears it was found.
Pell's drawing (man), read with a hand: what it shows, and the story hears it was found.
The story keeps which of Pell's drawings have been found.

The crown shrine on the Pilgrim's Road: laid something worn on the head (G), it takes it, lights (lit), tells the story (ch1.shrines.crown) and the one who laid it (faith +5); laid a relic, something important or bound, or a keepsake, it refuses it and does not take it; laid anything else, it says what it asks; lit, it stays lit.

text.en: {host} stays dark. {item} is not something to give away.
text.zh: {host}没有亮起来。{item}不是能献出去的东西。

text.en: You lay {item} on {host}. A light kindles in the carving.
text.zh: 你把{item}放在{host}上。刻痕里亮起了一点光。

text.en: Nothing kindles. {host} asks for something worn on the head.
text.zh: 什么也没亮起来。{host}要的是一件戴在头上的东西。

rules.doc: The scourge shrine on the Pilgrim's Road: laid a rope or a cord (G), it takes it, lights (lit), tells the story (ch1.shrines.scourge) and the one who laid it (faith +5); laid a relic, something important or bound, or a keepsake, it refuses it and does not take it; laid anything else, it says what it asks; lit, it stays lit.

text.zh: 你把{item}放在{host}上。刻痕里亮起了一点光。

text.en: Nothing kindles. {host} asks for a rope or a cord.
text.zh: 什么也没亮起来。{host}要的是一根绳索。

rules.doc: The scales shrine on the Pilgrim's Road: laid something to eat (G), it takes it, lights (lit), tells the story (ch1.shrines.scales) and the one who laid it (faith +5); laid a relic, something important or bound, or a keepsake, it refuses it and does not take it; laid anything else, it says what it asks; lit, it stays lit.

text.zh: 你把{item}放在{host}上。刻痕里亮起了一点光。

text.en: Nothing kindles. {host} asks for something to eat.
text.zh: 什么也没亮起来。{host}要的是一样吃的。

rules.doc: The nails shrine on the Pilgrim's Road: laid something made of metal (G), it takes it, lights (lit), tells the story (ch1.shrines.nails) and the one who laid it (faith +5); laid a relic, something important or bound, or a keepsake, it refuses it and does not take it; laid anything else, it says what it asks; lit, it stays lit.

text.zh: 你把{item}放在{host}上。刻痕里亮起了一点光。

text.en: Nothing kindles. {host} asks for something made of metal.
text.zh: 什么也没亮起来。{host}要的是一件金属的东西。

rules.doc: The lance shrine on the Pilgrim's Road: laid a torch or a candle (G), it takes it, lights (lit), tells the story (ch1.shrines.lance) and the one who laid it (faith +5); laid a relic, something important or bound, or a keepsake, it refuses it and does not take it; laid anything else, it says what it asks; lit, it stays lit.

text.zh: {host}没有亮起来。{item}不是能献出去的东西。

text.zh: 你把{item}放在{host}上。刻痕里亮起了一点光。

text.en: Nothing kindles. {host} asks for a torch or a candle.
text.zh: 什么也没亮起来。{host}要的是火把或蜡烛。

rules.doc: The Oath-Thorn used on oneself: one steps into the Held Ground (or, in it, back out where one stood) — told so, one goes oneself. Not in the middle of a fight: the thorn does not open while something is after one, nor take the fight in with one.

text.en: Not now, not in the middle of a fight.

label.zh: 进入 / 离开誓守之地
进入 / 离开誓守之地

rules.doc: The steward spoken to about the ground (his talk's "The Held Ground…"): its panel (the land, its grounds, its buildings, the stock); asked to build one (choice build:<id>), he builds it from the stock if the land is ready for it and the stock holds all it asks; asked to go to a ground (choice go:<id>), he sends one there once it is opened.

text.en: There. The mist has drawn back as far as the trees. I will hold this much for you, and more when you bring what it asks.
text.zh: 好了。迷雾退到树林那边去了。这一片，我替你守着。你再带东西来，我便守得更远。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: More ground. I remember fields like this, once. Whose they were, I do not.
text.zh: 又多了一片地。我记得从前见过这样的田野。是谁家的，我已经想不起来了。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: That is all the ground there is. ...It is more than I held before, and no one here kneels to me.
text.zh: 这就是全部的地了。……比我从前守的还要大。而这里，没有人向我下跪。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: There was a quarry under the mist. The stone is good. It would make walls, if we ever have need of them.
text.zh: 迷雾底下原来是一处采石场。石头很好，真要筑墙，也够用了。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: Trees, and old ones. They stood here before ever I wore the crown.
text.zh: 是树，还是老树。在我戴上那顶冠之前，它们就在这里了。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: Listen. Water. I had forgotten what it sounds like.
text.zh: 听。是水声。我已经忘了它是什么声音了。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: Warm water out of cold rock. Sit in it a while. I will keep watch.
text.zh: 冷石头里涌出来的热水。去泡一会儿吧，我替你守着。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: A bench, and room to work at it. Make what you need; I will not ask what it is for.
text.zh: 一张工作台，还有干活的地方。你需要什么就做什么，做来干什么，我不过问。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: Iron on the bench now, and a better light to work by. Nearly a craftsman's room.
text.zh: 台上有了铁器，也有了更亮的灯。差不多是间匠人的屋子了。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: A bellows. My father had one like it. The fire answers it as it answered him.
text.zh: 一架风箱。我父亲也有过一架这样的。炉火应它，就像当年应我父亲一样。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: Steel over iron. Now it will take a blow without giving. Make something worthy of the anvil.
text.zh: 铁上覆了钢，如今重锤落下也不会塌了。打些配得上这块砧的东西吧。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: I never trusted the arcane. But the order kept a mage, and we were glad of her more than once. Use it well.
text.zh: 我向来信不过奥术。可骑士团里养着一位法师，我们不止一次庆幸有她在。好好用吧。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: Frost and fire on one table. Whatever you learn here, practise it away from the tents.
text.zh: 冰与火摆在同一张桌上。在这里学到的东西，要练，就离帐篷远些。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: A fire that stays lit. Eat something. I hold this ground for you; I will not have you go hungry on it.
text.zh: 一堆不会熄的火。吃点东西吧。这片地我替你守着，不能让你在这里饿着。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: Walls and a roof for what you keep. Nothing in it will be taken; I sleep lightly.
text.zh: 你的东西有了墙，也有了顶。不会有人拿走的，我睡得很浅。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: A loom. Someone used to weave the order's banners. I do not remember who. It does not matter now.
text.zh: 一架织布机。从前有人给骑士团织军旗。是谁，我记不得了。如今也不要紧了。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.
text.zh: 还不行：库存的材料不够，或者领地还没扩到这一步。

text.en: A tent with two cots in it. I once had a hundred men under canvas. Two will do, to begin with.
text.zh: 一顶营帐，两张行军床。我帐下从前有过一百个人。先有两个，也好。

text.en: Not yet: the stock is short of something, or the ground is not ready for it.

A hand on the fog before a boss's arena (its interior props): one passes through into the arena, and the fog is one's home from now on (where one rises after a fall, its stake). A fog inside an arena, sealed while its boss stands: it does not part, and says so. Its boss fallen: it lifts.

text.en: The fog will not part while it stands.

rules.doc: Anything else done to a boss's fog — a blow, a fire, something put to it or used on it — passes through mist: defined, nothing changes, so nothing breaks into a boss's room but by its door (docs/boss-rooms.md). Its boss fallen, it lifts.

text.en: It passes through the fog as through smoke. The fog closes again.
text.zh: 像穿过一缕烟一样穿过了雾。雾又合拢了。

rules.doc: A boss's fog looks now and then (its period) whether the story knows its boss fallen: if so it lifts, and the way under it is open.
A boss told the one it fought has fallen and gone (body/rise, rising at home): it is whole again — its health, its fight from the first phase, its post.

props.text: By the Church of the Five Sufferings, to every parish and every road: the Seal-bearers can no longer carry what Astra laid upon them. Dusk comes earlier, dawn later; should the five Seals fail, the Long Night falls a second time. The pilgrimage is called. Let the pilgrim seek out the five Seal-bearers, bring back the five instruments, and come to the Holy City for the Rite of the Five Sufferings. Named to this road: the one who came down from the mountain with a fairy. — Sealed in the Holy City.
props.text_zh: 五苦圣教，致各教区、各条道路：五位持印者已无法继续承担阿斯特拉留下的五苦。黄昏一日早过一日，黎明一日迟过一日；五印若尽衰，第二次极夜终将降临。今召朝圣。朝圣者当寻访五位持印者，取回五件圣刑之器，前往圣城，重行五苦大礼。受命踏上此路者：从山上下来、身边跟着一只妖精的人。——圣城用印

props.text: Sunset after sunset in a neat column, each a little earlier than the last. On the last pages the hand changes — hurried, pressed so hard the pen has torn the paper: "No sun today. None today. He says he will take it all. Whoever reads this — stop him." After that, nothing.
props.text_zh: 一行行工整的日落时刻，每一行都比上一行早一点。最后几页，字迹变了——仓促，用力得笔尖划破了纸：「今天没有太阳。今天也没有。他说他会把一切都担下来。读到这里的人——阻止他。」再往后，什么也没有。

props.text: A bronze seal on a chain: a ring of thorns, and in it a knight kneeling — not before a lord, before a child. Around the rim: WE HOLD, THAT OTHERS NEED NOT.
props.text_zh: 链子上挂着一枚青铜印章：一圈荆棘，圈里一个骑士单膝跪下——跪的不是领主，而是一个孩子。边缘刻着：我们坚守，好让别人不必。

props.text: A writ of relief under the wax seal of the Order. It reads: Alberic, Bearer of the Crown, has borne the seal forty years; another shall be sent to relieve him. — The wax is whole. It was never opened, and never sent. On the back, one line in fresher ink: "No one could be found who would bear it. Let him go on holding."
props.text_zh: 一份盖着骑士团火漆的替任文书。上面写着：持冠者阿尔贝里克承印已满四十年，当另派一人接替。——火漆完好，没有拆过，也没有寄出去。背面有一行字，墨色比正文新："找不到愿意承受的人。就让他继续守着吧。"

doc.en: Dodge +5%: a direct combat blow misses you entirely.
doc.zh: 闪避 +5%：直接战斗攻击有几率完全落空。

doc.en: Dodge +7% more (dodge is capped at 50%).
doc.zh: 闪避再 +7%（闪避上限 50%）。

doc.en: Dash goes 1 tile farther, and its cooldown is 1.5 seconds shorter.

doc.en: Dash passes through creatures, and nothing can hit you for 0.5 seconds after.
doc.zh: 冲刺可以穿过生物，冲刺后 0.5 秒内不会受到攻击。

doc.en: Critical damage +25% (×1.5 becomes ×1.75).
Critical damage +25% more.

doc.zh: 攻击满血目标时伤害 +30%。

doc.en: At or below half health: damage +25% and critical chance +10%.

doc.en: Max health +4.

doc.en: Defence +1: every blow you take is one weaker.

doc.en: Max health +6.

doc.en: At or below 30% health, direct combat damage taken is reduced by 25%. Minimum 1; not hunger or environmental damage.

doc.en: You grow hungry a third more slowly.
doc.zh: 饥饿速度降低三分之一。

doc.en: Defence +1.
doc.zh: 防御 +1。

doc.en: Food fills you 50% more.
doc.zh: 食物恢复的饱食度 +50%。

doc.en: You heal whenever your food bar is at least a quarter full.

doc.zh: 每天一次：任何致命伤害（攻击、火焰、饥饿）都会让你保留 30% 生命，并在 3 秒内免疫伤害。

doc.zh: 使用匕首攻击时威力 +1。刺客的所有天赋都只对匕首生效，通用武器无效。

doc.en: After 4 seconds without attacking or taking combat damage, the next primary melee hit gains 50% damage. This is an opener, not invisibility.
doc.zh: 连续 4 秒未攻击且未受到战斗伤害后，下一次近战主目标命中伤害 +50%；这是先手蓄势，不是隐身。

doc.en: Every third primary melee hit on the same actor gains 60% damage. Each hit must land within 2 seconds; changing target, missing or using a ranged attack resets the combo.
doc.zh: 对同一生物的每第 3 次近战主目标命中，伤害 +60%。相邻命中间隔不得超过 2 秒；换目标、挥空或远程攻击会中断连击。

doc.en: Primary melee attacks from behind the target gain 40% damage, judged by the target facing. Side and front attacks do not qualify.
doc.zh: 从目标背后进行近战主目标攻击，伤害 +40%；根据目标朝向判断，侧面和正面不触发。

doc.en: Defeating a creature with a dagger restores 10% of max health, rounded up; never above max health.
doc.zh: 用匕首击败生物时，恢复生命上限的 10%（向上取整），不超过生命上限。

doc.en: A qualifying Ambush or Backstab is guaranteed to critically hit. Does not turn Sweep secondary hits into critical openers.
doc.zh: 触发暗影先手或背刺的攻击必定暴击；不会让横扫副目标获得先手或背刺暴击。

doc.en: Sword attacks gain +1 power. Like every warrior talent that strikes, it answers swords only, never common weapons.
doc.zh: 使用剑攻击时威力 +1。战士的攻击类天赋都只对剑生效，通用武器无效。

doc.en: Direct combat damage taken −15%. Minimum 1; not hunger or environmental damage.
doc.zh: 受到的直接战斗伤害 −15%，最低仍为 1；不减免饥饿或环境伤害。

doc.en: Max health +10.
doc.zh: 生命上限 +10。

doc.en: Within 2 seconds of taking a combat hit, your next primary sword hit gains 40% damage.
doc.zh: 受到战斗伤害后的 2 秒内，下一次用剑的主目标命中伤害 +40%。

doc.en: Felling a creature with a sword: +15% sword damage for 5 seconds, stacking up to three times.
doc.zh: 用剑击倒生物后，5 秒内剑的伤害 +15%，最多叠加 3 层。

doc.en: Bulwark rises to −30%, and every Retaliation hit that lands restores 2 health.
doc.zh: 铁壁减伤提高到 30%；每次以牙还牙命中恢复 2 点生命。

doc.en: Bows gain +1 power and +1 range. Ranger talents answer bows only.
doc.zh: 弓的威力 +1，射程 +1。游侠天赋只对弓生效。

doc.en: Bow hits gain 30% damage when you have not moved for 1 second.
doc.zh: 1 秒内没有移动时，弓箭命中伤害 +30%。

doc.en: Bow hits on targets 3 or more tiles away gain 25% damage.
doc.zh: 弓箭命中 3 格及以外的目标时，伤害 +25%。

doc.en: After a bow hit lands, movement speed +20% for 1.5 seconds.
doc.zh: 弓箭命中后，1.5 秒内移动速度 +20%。

doc.en: Attack speed +20% while holding a bow.
doc.zh: 手持弓时攻击速度 +20%。

doc.en: Every third bow hit in a row on the same target is a guaranteed critical hit.
doc.zh: 对同一目标连续第 3 次弓箭命中必定暴击。

doc.en: Staves gain +1 power. Mage talents answer staves only; a wand is a common weapon.
doc.zh: 法杖的威力 +1。法师天赋只对法杖生效；魔杖是通用武器。

doc.en: Spells from a staff with an element (fire, ice, lightning…) gain 25% damage.
doc.zh: 带元素（火、冰、雷……）的法杖施法伤害 +25%。

doc.en: Every fourth spell that lands is a guaranteed critical hit.
doc.zh: 每第 4 次命中的法术必定暴击。

doc.en: Direct combat damage taken −20% while holding a staff.
doc.zh: 手持法杖时，受到的直接战斗伤害 −20%。

doc.en: Felling a creature with a staff restores 3 health.
doc.zh: 用法杖击倒生物时恢复 3 点生命。

doc.en: Staves gain +2 more power and +1 range.
doc.zh: 法杖的威力再 +2，射程 +1。

doc.en: Dropped things fly to you from two tiles farther.
doc.zh: 掉落物的吸取范围扩大 2 格。

doc.en: A tree you fell gives one more log.
doc.zh: 砍倒的树多掉一根木头。

doc.en: One more row in the bag.
doc.zh: 背包多一行。

doc.en: Light a campfire, brazier or candles with a plain stick.
doc.zh: 用一根普通树枝就能点燃营火、火盆或蜡烛。

doc.en: Spin: strike every foe on the eight cells around you (×1.2). Cooldown 8 s.
doc.zh: 原地旋转，攻击周围 8 格的所有敌人（1.2 倍伤害）。冷却 8 秒。

doc.en: One heavy blow on the cell ahead (×2.5). Cooldown 6 s.
doc.zh: 对前方一格重重劈下（2.5 倍伤害）。冷却 6 秒。

doc.en: Movement speed +50% for 5 seconds. Cooldown 20 s.
doc.zh: 5 秒内移动速度 +50%。冷却 20 秒。

doc.en: Restore 30% of your max health at once. Cooldown 30 s.
doc.zh: 立即恢复 30% 生命上限的生命。冷却 30 秒。

doc.en: Step out of the shadows behind the nearest foe within 4 cells and strike (×1.5; Backstab applies). Cooldown 10 s.
doc.zh: 闪到 4 格内最近敌人的背后并攻击（1.5 倍伤害，可触发背刺）。冷却 10 秒。

doc.en: Your next 5 blows each open a bleed (1 a second for 4 seconds). Cooldown 20 s.
doc.zh: 接下来 5 次攻击都会让目标流血（4 秒内每秒 1 点）。冷却 20 秒。

doc.en: For 3 seconds no creature can see you to attack you. Cooldown 25 s.
doc.zh: 3 秒内怪物看不见你，不会攻击你。冷却 25 秒。

doc.en: Four quick stabs on the cell ahead (×0.6 each). Cooldown 8 s.
doc.zh: 对前方一格快速连刺 4 次（每次 0.6 倍伤害）。冷却 8 秒。

doc.en: Strike the cell ahead and stun it for 1.5 seconds. Cooldown 10 s.
doc.zh: 攻击前方一格并使其眩晕 1.5 秒。冷却 10 秒。

doc.en: Rush up to 3 cells ahead into the first foe and strike it (×1.5, a moment's stun). Cooldown 12 s.
doc.zh: 向前冲锋最多 3 格，撞上第一个敌人并攻击（1.5 倍伤害，短暂眩晕）。冷却 12 秒。

doc.en: For 5 seconds: damage dealt +25%, combat damage taken −30%. Cooldown 25 s.
doc.zh: 5 秒内造成的伤害 +25%，受到的战斗伤害 −30%。冷却 25 秒。

doc.en: Slam the ground: every foe on the 3×3 two cells ahead is struck (×1.3) and staggered. Cooldown 12 s.
doc.zh: 重击地面：前方两格处 3×3 范围内的敌人受到攻击（1.3 倍伤害）并被震晕片刻。冷却 12 秒。

doc.en: Three arrows side by side, each striking the first foe in its line (×0.8). Cooldown 8 s.
doc.zh: 并排射出 3 支箭，各自命中所在直线上的第一个敌人（0.8 倍伤害）。冷却 8 秒。

doc.en: Leap 2 cells back and loose an arrow ahead (×1.2). Cooldown 10 s.
doc.zh: 向后跃 2 格，同时向前射出一箭（1.2 倍伤害）。冷却 10 秒。

doc.en: An arrow through every foe in its line, up to the first wall (×1.3). Cooldown 10 s.
doc.zh: 一箭贯穿直线上的所有敌人，直到墙壁（1.3 倍伤害）。冷却 10 秒。

doc.en: Arrows fall on the 3×3 around the first foe ahead, once a second for 3 seconds (×0.6 each). Cooldown 20 s.
doc.zh: 在前方第一个敌人周围 3×3 范围落下箭雨，每秒一轮，持续 3 秒（每轮 0.6 倍伤害）。冷却 20 秒。

doc.en: A ball of fire that bursts on the first thing ahead, striking the 3×3 around it (×1.5, fire). Cooldown 6 s.
doc.zh: 发射火球，在前方第一个目标处爆炸，波及周围 3×3（1.5 倍火焰伤害）。冷却 6 秒。

doc.en: Every foe within 2 cells is struck by ice (×0.5) and frozen for 2 seconds. Cooldown 15 s.
doc.zh: 周围 2 格内的敌人受到冰霜伤害（0.5 倍）并被冻结 2 秒。冷却 15 秒。

doc.en: Lightning strikes the first foe ahead and leaps on to 2 more nearby (×1.2 each). Cooldown 10 s.
doc.zh: 闪电击中前方第一个敌人，再跳向附近的另外 2 个（每次 1.2 倍伤害）。冷却 10 秒。

doc.en: Vanish and reappear up to 4 cells ahead, through creatures but not walls. Cooldown 12 s.
doc.zh: 瞬移到前方最多 4 格处，可穿过生物，不能穿墙。冷却 12 秒。

doc.en: Throw a knife at the first foe ahead, up to 5 cells (×1.0). Cooldown 5 s.
doc.zh: 向前掷出飞刀，命中 5 格内第一个敌人（1.0 倍伤害）。冷却 5 秒。

doc.en: Blades spin out to every foe on the eight cells around you (×0.8), and they bleed. Cooldown 10 s.
doc.zh: 刀刃向四周旋出，攻击周围 8 格的敌人（0.8 倍伤害）并使其流血。冷却 10 秒。

doc.en: Ultimate: step behind up to 3 foes within 5 cells, one after another, striking each (×1.5). Cooldown 25 s.
doc.zh: 终极：依次闪到 5 格内至多 3 个敌人背后，各攻击一次（1.5 倍伤害）。冷却 25 秒。

doc.en: Shadow Strike: cooldown −3 s, reach +2 cells.
doc.zh: 影袭：冷却 −3 秒，距离 +2 格。

doc.en: Envenom: 3 more poisoned blows.
doc.zh: 淬毒：淬毒次数 +3。

doc.en: Smoke Bomb: lasts 2 s longer.
doc.zh: 烟雾弹：持续 +2 秒。

doc.en: Flurry: 2 more stabs.
doc.zh: 千刃：连刺 +2 次。

doc.en: Fan of Knives: power +0.3.
doc.zh: 回旋刃：伤害倍率 +0.3。

doc.en: With a dagger: +20% damage to a bleeding target.
doc.zh: 持匕首攻击流血中的目标时伤害 +20%。

doc.en: With a dagger: +15% damage at night.
doc.zh: 持匕首在夜晚造成的伤害 +15%。

doc.en: With a dagger in hand: dodge +8%.
doc.zh: 手持匕首时闪避 +8%。

doc.en: Capstone: whenever you fell a creature, Shadow Strike is ready again at once.
doc.zh: 终极天赋：每击倒一个生物，影袭的冷却立即刷新。

doc.en: One sweep across the three cells ahead (×1.3). Cooldown 6 s.
doc.zh: 一刀横扫前方 3 格（1.3 倍伤害）。冷却 6 秒。

doc.en: For 3 seconds: combat damage taken −60%, but you move slower. Cooldown 20 s.
doc.zh: 3 秒内受到的战斗伤害 −60%，但移动变慢。冷却 20 秒。

doc.en: Ultimate: one great blow down the 5×3 cells ahead (×2.5), stunning what it strikes. Cooldown 30 s.
doc.zh: 终极：向前方 5×3 范围劈下巨剑（2.5 倍伤害），并使其眩晕。冷却 30 秒。

doc.en: Shield Bash: stun +1 s.
doc.zh: 盾击：眩晕 +1 秒。

doc.en: Charge: 2 cells farther.
doc.zh: 冲锋：距离 +2 格。

doc.en: War Cry: lasts 3 s longer.
doc.zh: 战吼：持续 +3 秒。

doc.en: Earthsplitter: power +0.4.
doc.zh: 裂地：伤害倍率 +0.4。

doc.en: Wide Slash: power +0.4.
doc.zh: 横劈：伤害倍率 +0.4。

doc.en: With a shield worn: block chance +5%.
doc.zh: 佩戴盾牌时格挡率 +5%。

doc.en: Whenever you fell a creature: mend 5% of your max health.
doc.zh: 每击倒一个生物，恢复 5% 生命上限的生命。

doc.en: What a blow leaves to hold you still (a stun, a freeze, kneeling) lasts half as long.
doc.zh: 被攻击附带的控制效果（眩晕、冰冻、跪地）持续时间减半。

doc.en: Capstone: whenever you fell a creature, every skill comes 1 s nearer to ready.
doc.zh: 终极天赋：每击倒一个生物，所有技能的冷却 −1 秒。

doc.en: An arrow that stuns the first foe in its line for 1 s (×1.0). Cooldown 8 s.
doc.zh: 射出一箭，命中直线上第一个敌人并使其眩晕 1 秒（1.0 倍伤害）。冷却 8 秒。

doc.en: For 5 seconds: a shooting weapon reaches 3 cells farther, critical chance +20%. Cooldown 25 s.
doc.zh: 5 秒内射击武器射程 +3 格，暴击率 +20%。冷却 25 秒。

doc.en: Ultimate: five arrows side by side, each through every foe in its line (×1.2). Cooldown 30 s.
doc.zh: 终极：并排射出 5 支箭，每支都贯穿所在直线上的所有敌人（1.2 倍伤害）。冷却 30 秒。

doc.en: Multishot: 2 more arrows.
doc.zh: 多重箭：箭数 +2。

doc.en: Leap Shot: 1 cell farther back, cooldown −2 s.
doc.zh: 后跃射击：后跳 +1 格，冷却 −2 秒。

doc.en: Piercing Arrow: power +0.5.
doc.zh: 穿透箭：伤害倍率 +0.5。

doc.en: Arrow Rain: 2 more volleys.
doc.zh: 箭雨：轮数 +2。

doc.en: Concussive Shot: stun +1 s.
doc.zh: 震荡箭：眩晕 +1 秒。

doc.en: Movement speed +10%.
doc.zh: 移动速度 +10%。

doc.en: With a bow: critical damage +25%.
doc.zh: 持弓时暴击伤害 +25%。

doc.en: With a bow in hand: dodge +5%.
doc.zh: 手持弓时闪避 +5%。

doc.en: Capstone: each cast that hits brings your other skills 0.5 s nearer to ready.
doc.zh: 终极天赋：每次技能命中，其他技能的冷却 −0.5 秒。

doc.en: A bolt of ice at the first foe ahead (×1.2, ice), freezing it for 1 s. Cooldown 5 s.
doc.zh: 向前射出寒冰箭，命中第一个敌人（1.2 倍冰霜伤害）并冻结 1 秒。冷却 5 秒。

doc.en: Lightning falls on the 3×3 around the first foe ahead, once a second for 3 seconds (×0.7 each). Cooldown 20 s.
doc.zh: 在前方第一个敌人周围 3×3 降下落雷，每秒一轮，持续 3 秒（每轮 0.7 倍雷电伤害）。冷却 20 秒。

doc.en: Ultimate: a meteor on the first thing ahead, burning the 5×5 around it (×3.0, fire). Cooldown 35 s.
doc.zh: 终极：召唤陨石砸向前方第一个目标，焚烧周围 5×5（3.0 倍火焰伤害）。冷却 35 秒。

doc.en: Fireball: power +0.5.
doc.zh: 火球：伤害倍率 +0.5。

doc.en: Frost Nova: radius +1 cell.
doc.zh: 冰霜新星：半径 +1 格。

doc.en: Chain Lightning: 2 more targets.
doc.zh: 闪电链：目标数 +2。

doc.en: Blink: 2 cells farther, cooldown −3 s.
doc.zh: 闪现：距离 +2 格，冷却 −3 秒。

doc.en: Frost Bolt: frozen 1 s longer.
doc.zh: 寒冰箭：冻结 +1 秒。

doc.en: Every skill's cooldown −10%.
doc.zh: 所有技能冷却 −10%。

doc.en: What carries an element strikes 15% harder (a staff with one, an element's spell).
doc.zh: 带元素的攻击伤害 +15%（带元素的法杖、元素法术）。

doc.en: Max health +10.
doc.zh: 生命上限 +10。

doc.en: Capstone: every third skill you cast does not rest.
doc.zh: 终极天赋：每第 3 次施放的技能不进入冷却。

doc.en: Your axe bites half again as deep into a tree.
doc.zh: 斧头砍树的伤害 +50%。

doc.en: Splitting a log gives one more plank.
doc.zh: 劈开木头多得 1 块木板。

doc.en: Every tree you fell drops an acorn.
doc.zh: 每砍倒一棵树都会掉一颗橡子。

doc.en: Capstone: every tree you fell gives one more log and one more stick.
doc.zh: 终极：每砍倒一棵树多得 1 根原木和 1 根树枝。

doc.en: An ore vein you break gives one more ore.
doc.zh: 敲碎的矿脉多掉 1 块矿石。

doc.en: Your pickaxe strikes half again as hard.
doc.zh: 镐的力量 +50%。

doc.en: Rock and boulders you break give one more stone.
doc.zh: 敲碎的岩石和巨石多掉 1 块石头。

doc.en: An ore vein you break sometimes holds a gem (12%).
doc.zh: 敲碎矿脉时有 12% 几率找到宝石。

doc.en: Capstone: an ore vein you break gives one more ore again.
doc.zh: 终极：敲碎的矿脉再多掉 1 块矿石。

doc.en: Mushroom rings and reeds give one more; wild beehives aside.
doc.zh: 采蘑菇圈、割芦苇多得 1 份。

doc.en: A healing herb you eat heals twice as much.
doc.zh: 吃下的草药恢复的生命翻倍。

doc.en: Fish bite more often: 85% on a baited hook, 50% without.
doc.zh: 鱼更容易咬钩：挂饵时 85%，不挂饵时 50%。

doc.en: Half the time a fish takes your bait clean, the bait is still on the hook.
doc.zh: 鱼吃掉鱼饵却没上钩时，有一半几率鱼饵还在。

doc.en: Golden carp and Dawnscales bite twice as often.
doc.zh: 金鳞鲤和晨鳞鱼上钩的几率翻倍。

doc.en: Pike bite in any water, not only the deep.
doc.zh: 在任何水域都能钓到狗鱼，不只是深水。

doc.en: Capstone: every catch brings up one more fish.
doc.zh: 终极：每次钓到东西都额外多得 1 条鱼。

doc.en: A crop you harvest gives one more seed.
doc.zh: 收割作物多得 1 颗种子。

doc.en: Picking a ripe crop by hand gives two.
doc.zh: 用手采摘成熟作物得 2 份。

doc.en: Tilling also tills the diggable ground around it (3×3).
doc.zh: 翻土时连同周围 3×3 的地一起翻好。

doc.en: A crop you harvest with a sickle gives one more.
doc.zh: 用镰刀收割多得 1 份作物。

doc.en: Seeds and saplings bought at the stall come half again as many.
doc.zh: 在货摊买种子多得 50%。

doc.en: A perennial you harvest keeps its fertilizer and its yield as it grows back.
doc.zh: 多年生作物收获后保留施肥效果和产量。

doc.en: Tomatoes, corn, peppers and eggplants give two more at harvest.
doc.zh: 番茄、玉米、辣椒、茄子收获时多得 2 份。

doc.en: Berries, blueberries and strawberries give two more at harvest.
doc.zh: 浆果、蓝莓、草莓收获时多得 2 份。

doc.en: One watering supplies two growth stages, at the crop's normal pace.
doc.zh: 浇一次水可供作物连续生长两个阶段，生长速度不变。

doc.en: Watering a crop waters the growing crops around it too.
doc.zh: 浇一株作物时，周围生长中的作物也一起浇上水。

doc.en: Make fertilizer from three grass and an ash, by hand.
doc.zh: 学会堆肥：用 3 把草和 1 份灰烬手工做出肥料。

doc.en: Fertilizer or ash you work in gives one more at harvest again.
doc.zh: 施肥（或灰烬）让收成再多 1 份。

doc.en: Wheat gives two more at harvest.
doc.zh: 小麦收获时多得 2 份。

doc.en: Carrots, turnips, parsnips, potatoes and radishes give two more at harvest.
doc.zh: 胡萝卜、芜菁、防风草、土豆、小萝卜收获时多得 2 份。

doc.en: Pumpkins, melons and cauliflower give one more at harvest.
doc.zh: 南瓜、甜瓜、花椰菜收获时多得 1 份。

doc.en: Herbs give two more at harvest.
doc.zh: 草药收获时多得 2 份。

doc.en: A plant you dig up gives two more seeds.
doc.zh: 用铲子挖出作物时多得 2 颗种子。

doc.en: Crops sell for 25% more at the stall.
doc.zh: 在货摊卖作物多得 25% 的钱。

doc.en: Capstone: a harvest sometimes (15%) yields twice over.
doc.zh: 终极：收割时有 15% 几率收成翻倍。

doc.en: Capstone: every harvest gives one more crop and one more seed again.
doc.zh: 终极：每次收割再多 1 份作物和 1 颗种子。

doc.zh: 你喂的动物饱腹状态持续两天。

doc.en: A cow you milk can be milked again after half a day.
doc.zh: 挤过奶的牛半天后就能再挤。

doc.zh: 喂母鸡时它立刻下一个蛋。

doc.en: Animals you feed sometimes (30%) bear twins.
doc.zh: 你喂的动物繁殖时有 30% 几率生双胞胎。

doc.zh: 宰杀牛或鸡多得 1 份肉。

doc.en: Bees do not sting you, and a hive gives you one more honey.
doc.zh: 取蜂蜜时不会被蜇，并多得 1 罐蜂蜜。

doc.en: Milk over a fire gives one more cheese.
doc.zh: 用牛奶做奶酪多得 1 块。

doc.en: Milk over a fire gives one more cheese again.
doc.zh: 用牛奶做奶酪再多得 1 块。

doc.en: A hen you feed lays one more egg at once.
doc.zh: 喂母鸡时它再多下一个蛋。

doc.en: A hen you feed sometimes (15%) hatches a chick of its own.
doc.zh: 喂母鸡时有 15% 几率孵出一只小鸡。

doc.en: Animals that bred from your feeding rest half a day, not a day.
doc.zh: 你喂的动物繁殖后只需休息半天。

doc.en: Feeding one animal feeds the hungry ones around it too.
doc.zh: 喂一只动物时，周围没吃饱的动物也一起喂饱。

doc.en: Two wheat make five feed, not three.
doc.zh: 用 2 份小麦做饲料得 5 份（原来 3 份）。

doc.en: A cow you fell leaves its hide (leather).
doc.zh: 宰杀牛时得到 1 张皮革。

doc.en: Make leather gloves, boots, helmets, pauldrons and breastplates (once the Held Ground's weaving shed stands).
doc.zh: 学会用皮革做手套、靴子、头盔、护肩和胸甲（需领地建好织坊）。

doc.en: A hen you fell leaves two feathers.
doc.zh: 宰杀鸡时得到 2 根羽毛。

doc.en: Build a bee box (four planks and a honey) once the Held Ground's workshop stands.
doc.zh: 学会用 4 块木板和 1 罐蜂蜜做蜂箱（需领地建好工坊）。

doc.en: A hive gives you one more honey again.
doc.zh: 取蜂蜜再多得 1 罐。

doc.en: Milk, eggs, cheese, honey, leather and feathers sell for 25% more.
doc.zh: 牛奶、鸡蛋、奶酪、蜂蜜、皮革、羽毛在货摊多卖 25%。

doc.en: Capstone: one more of everything the ranch gives you — eggs, cheese, honey, meat.
doc.zh: 终极：牧场的每样产出都再多 1 份——鸡蛋、奶酪、蜂蜜、肉。

doc.en: What you forge on an anvil is made as by a smith one level higher (its quality).
doc.zh: 在铁砧上锻造时，按高 1 级的水平决定品质。

doc.en: Build your own forge (eight stone, two coal) and anvil (three ingots, at a forge).
doc.zh: 学会自己搭熔炉（8 块石头、2 块煤）和铁砧（3 块锭，在熔炉旁做）。

doc.en: Every smelting gives one more ingot.
doc.zh: 每次冶炼多得 1 块锭。

doc.en: Weapons you forge strike 1 harder.
doc.zh: 你锻造的武器威力 +1。

doc.en: Armour you forge guards 1 better.
doc.zh: 你锻造的护甲防御 +1。

doc.en: What you forge is made as by a smith two levels higher again.
doc.zh: 锻造时再按高 2 级的水平决定品质。

doc.en: Smelt steel (three iron ore, three coal): the strongest common metal.
doc.zh: 学会炼钢（3 块铁矿、3 块煤），钢是最好的普通金属。

doc.en: Smelt gold (two gold ore, one coal).
doc.zh: 学会炼金（2 块金矿、1 块煤）。

doc.en: Forge rings and amulets from ingots.
doc.zh: 学会用锭锻造戒指和护符。

doc.en: Ore and coal sell for half again as much.
doc.zh: 矿石和煤在货摊多卖 50%。

doc.en: Forge metal axes, pickaxes, hoes, sickles and shovels.
doc.zh: 学会锻造金属的斧头、镐、锄头、镰刀和铲子。

doc.en: Weapons you forge have +5% critical chance.
doc.zh: 你锻造的武器暴击率 +5%。

doc.en: Forge warhammers and halberds.
doc.zh: 学会锻造战锤和戟。

doc.en: Weapons you forge strike 2 harder again.
doc.zh: 你锻造的武器威力再 +2。

doc.en: Forge pauldrons and breastplates.
doc.zh: 学会锻造护肩和胸甲。

doc.en: Armour you forge guards 1 better again.
doc.zh: 你锻造的护甲防御再 +1。

doc.en: Armour you forge guards 2 better again.
doc.zh: 你锻造的护甲防御再 +2。

doc.en: What you forge is now and then (15%) one quality better.
doc.zh: 锻造时有 15% 几率品质提升一级。

doc.en: Capstone: what you forge is sometimes (4%) Vowbound.
doc.zh: 终极：锻造时有 4% 几率打出「遗誓」品质。

doc.en: Capstone: what you forge is made as by a smith three levels higher again.
doc.zh: 终极：锻造时再按高 3 级的水平决定品质。

doc.en: Daggers, theirs alone; openers from the quiet and from behind, combos that end in a finisher.
doc.zh: 专精匕首；从暗处、从背后先手，连击收尾。

doc.en: Sword and shield, theirs alone; takes blows, answers them, and grows fiercer with each foe felled.
doc.zh: 专精剑盾，独有副手盾牌；扛得住打，挨打必还手，越战越勇。

doc.en: Bows, theirs alone; a steady aim from afar, quick feet between shots.
doc.zh: 专精弓箭；站稳了打得准、打得远，射完就走。

doc.en: Staves, theirs alone; elemental spells that echo, a shield of mana, strength drawn from the fallen.
doc.zh: 专精法杖；元素法术会回响，法力护盾护身，击倒敌人回复生命。

doc.en: From the First Seal, the Crown of Thorns. Experience gained +100%.
doc.zh: 来自第一印·荆棘冠。获得的经验 +100%。

skillNoProfession.en: No profession yet. At level 5, Bram the trainer sets you on one in the drill yard of Firstlight Village (crossed blades over his head): assassin, warrior, ranger or mage.
skillNoProfession.zh: 还没有职业。到 5 级后，去初原村操练场找职业导师布拉姆（头顶有交叉双剑标记）选择：刺客、战士、游侠或法师。

boonSealedDoc.en: Lumi takes up part of a seal's power when its bearer falls.
boonSealedDoc.zh: 击败持印者后，露米会接住其圣印的一部分力量。

boonOne.en: Lumi carries one power at a time.
boonOne.zh: 露米一次只能携带一种力量。

boonGained.en: Lumi takes up the seal's power

tier:vowed.en: Vowbound — left by one who swore a vow. It still remembers.
tier:vowed.zh: 遗誓——立誓之人留下的东西。它还记得那个誓言。

tier:legendary.en: Stigmatic — it bears one of the First Martyr's five wounds. Suffering brings one nearer to God.
tier:legendary.zh: 圣痕——它带着初殉者五道伤痕中的一道。苦难使人接近神。
